description: Why is a node failing? Trace the failing node up its dependency graph toward likely root-cause candidates, ranked with per-candidate classification (primary-failure vs downstream symptom). Returns a provenance-scored cause chain and recorded error context that file search cannot establish from runtime evidence. For the whole work order on a failure, call investigate or get_incident_card first.

errorId.description: Specific error event id from incident history; if set, the result is coloured with that error message

errorNode.description: Graph node id where the error surfaced, e.g. "database:payments-db"

project.description: Project name when the core hosts more than one (set NEAT_PROJECTS=...). Omit to use the default project.

name: get_root_cause
